notes.title: They Fear The Mist Revealed
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, the Steam Page for "They Fear The Mist" is now officially public. From now on we will try our best to keep you guys up to date with newly developed features and changes. We can’t promise any specific time intervals in which we will release them, but we guarantee you they will be coming!

I hope you are as excited as we are! You can join our Discord or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgtRiRkIBEaNCkTiCjDsfLg?sub_confirmation=1]follow us on YouTube[/url] to stay up to date, see you soon!

Most importantly, don't forget to Wishlist the game it helps us out immensely, cheers.
